checks.message: Provisional boundary is present and clearly labeled; replace with official redline before professional scoring.

Required Markdown, JSON, GeoJSON, PNG, PDF and offline HTML files are generated.

Static visualization is generated without external scripts, fonts, tiles, iframes, forms, tracking or CDN resources.
Official current-main self-check rerun locally after package repair.
